name: American Crew Fiber
description: High hold with low shine. Fiber-like, resinous product helps thicken, texturize and increase fullness to hair. Provides a strong, pliable hold with a matte finish.

name: Baxter Clay Pomade
description: Natural finish hair pomade with strong hold. Perfect for short to medium length hair. Works great on thick, coarse, and curly hair.

name: Layrite Super Hold Pomade
description: Water-based pomade with super hold and medium shine. Controls even the curliest and thickest hair. Washes out easily with water.

name: Suavecito Original Hold
description: Water-based pomade with strong hold and medium shine. Perfect for classic slick-back styles, pompadours, or side parts.

name: American Crew Forming Cream
description: Versatile styling cream with medium hold and natural shine. Provides pliable styling with a low shine finish.

name: Baxter Hard Cream
description: Water-based pomade/wax hybrid with strong hold and matte finish. Great for textured, messy styles.

name: Layrite Cement Clay
description: Water-based clay with extreme hold and matte finish. Perfect for thick, unruly hair that needs maximum control.

name: American Crew Firm Hold Gel
description: Provides high hold and high shine. Moisture-resistant formula for lasting control in humid conditions.

name: American Crew Daily Shampoo
description: Cleanses and invigorates hair and scalp. With naturally certified American Crew Citrus Mint that energizes and refreshes.

name: Baxter Daily Fortifying Shampoo
description: Strengthening shampoo for all hair types. Contains wheat protein and vitamin E to fortify hair.

name: American Crew Daily Conditioner
description: Detangles and moisturizes hair without weighing it down. Enhanced with Rosemary and Menthol to invigorate scalp.

name: Baxter Beard Oil
description: Premium blend of natural oils to condition, soften, and add shine to facial hair. Non-greasy formula.

name: Suavecito Premium Blends Beard Oil
description: Lightweight beard oil that moisturizes and softens beard hair. Contains natural oils including argan and jojoba.

name: Layrite Natural Matte Cream
description: Water-based styling cream with medium hold and matte finish. Great for natural, textured looks.

name: Suavecito Matte Pomade
description: Water-based pomade with strong hold and zero shine. Perfect for modern styles with a natural finish.
